Help & Guide

Understand every main section and how to use it step by step.

Quick tip: Use Search to find saved information, use your phone/tablet Back button to return through app pages, and use the moon/sun and gear controls for Theme and Settings.

Install & Open the App

Phone • Tablet • Computer

Phone

iPhone: open the hosted app link in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. Android: open it in Chrome → menu (⋮) → Install app or Add to Home screen.

Tablet

iPad: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Android tablet: Chrome → menu (⋮) → Install app / Add to Home screen.

Computer

Open the hosted Family Care Command Center in Chrome or Edge, then use the install icon in the address bar or the browser menu → Install app. The standalone Full Version HTML can also be opened directly in a modern browser.

Tip: The hosted PWA should be opened online once so offline files can be cached. Use Backup & Restore before clearing browser data or moving to another device.

Dashboard

See the whole family-care picture at a glance.

How to use it
  • Check the four summary cards for Tasks, Appointments, Medication Items and Family Updates.
  • Click any summary card to jump straight to its section.
  • Use the hero shortcuts for a Daily Update or Family Handoff.

Care Profiles

Create one organized profile for each person receiving care.

How to use it
  • Add the person’s name, relationship, phone number and general notes.
  • Use separate profiles when the family is coordinating care for more than one person.
  • Keep the profile practical and update details whenever they change.

Daily Log

Keep a simple record of what happened during the day.

How to use it
  • Choose the date, add who wrote the update, then write the important daily note.
  • Use this for practical observations and family coordination.
  • Review recent entries before another family member takes over.

Appointments

Keep upcoming visits and preparation notes together.

How to use it
  • Add the appointment title, date, time and place.
  • The status updates automatically from Upcoming to Today and then Past based on the appointment date.
  • Use the notes area for questions you want to remember before the visit.

Medications

Organize medication information in one easy-to-find list.

How to use it
  • Enter the medication name, the schedule shown on the label, dose/label text and notes.
  • Use this section as an organizer so family members see the same saved information.
  • It is for organization only and does not replace medical instructions or advice.

Tasks

Assign practical responsibilities and see what is still open.

How to use it
  • Add a task, choose who is responsible, set a due date and priority.
  • Mark the task Done when it is completed, or reopen it if follow-up is needed.
  • Open tasks are counted automatically on the dashboard.

Family Handoff

Pass clear updates from one family member to the next.

How to use it
  • Write who added the update and who/person it concerns.
  • Record what was completed and what still needs follow-up.
  • Use the latest handoff before taking over care so nothing important is missed.

Expenses

Track practical family-care spending in one place.

How to use it
  • Add the expense, amount, date and who paid it.
  • Use the history to see shared costs and make family reimbursement easier.
  • Keep entries descriptive so another family member understands what each cost was for.

Contacts

Keep important people and service details easy to reach.

How to use it
  • Save the contact name, role or relationship, phone and email.
  • Use it for family members and other important care-related contacts.
  • Update details when phone numbers or roles change.

Free Bonus

Use three clearly separated bonus tools: Emergency Prep, Appointment Prep and Family Care Quick Reference.

How to use it
  • Emergency Prep keeps family-provided essential information ready for quick access.
  • Appointment Prep helps collect questions, observations, instructions and follow-up notes.
  • Family Care Quick Reference keeps practical routines, preferences and household notes ready for another family member.
  • Each tool has its own numbered card and purpose, so the full bonus pack is easy to understand at a glance.

Documents

Track where important documents are stored.

How to use it
  • Add the document name, storage location, owner/person and a short note.
  • This version saves a reference to the document, not the actual file.
  • Use clear storage descriptions so another family member can find the document.

Settings

Manage app preferences and protect your locally saved data.

How to use it
  • Use Backup to download your saved data as a JSON file.
  • Use Restore when you want to load a previous backup.
  • Use the top-right theme button for Light/Dark Mode and the Settings icon for direct access.
